summary: Comprehensive test suite with strong coverage of core functionality (glob conversion, label resolution, priority ordering, error handling). Well-structured across three layers: unit tests (PRLabelAssigner.Tests.ps1), workflow structure validation (Workflow.Tests.ps1), and end-to-end integration via act (Act.Integration.Tests.ps1). Good edge case coverage including empty inputs, case sensitivity, missing files, malformed JSON, and label deduplication. Tests verify all stated requirements: TDD approach, Pester framework, error handling, and GitHub Actions workflow. Proper use of conditional skips for optional dependencies and parameterized tests. Minor gaps: some workflow failure scenarios untested, fixture structure documentation could be more explicit, act container setup details could be clearer. Overall, a well-designed suite with solid rigor that would reliably catch regressions in the label assignment logic.
